tips.tourAgain: Take it again any time from Help › Take the tour.
tips.turnedOffBody: Turn them on again in Settings › General › Tips and tours.

invite.title: New here? Take a quick tour
invite.body: This demo project is a pretend weekend away, filled in so you can try things safely. The tour visits each view in turn and points out what to try there, in {{count}} short steps.

welcome.title: The demo project
welcome.body: Everything here is made up, so change, move or delete anything you like. Its tasks read top to bottom: the first use the basics, later ones show more. Nothing you do here touches your own projects.

views.title: One project, many views
views.body: Each tab shows this project another way, and they all share the same tasks: change a task in one view and every other view shows the change. The next few steps visit each tab in turn.

board.title: Board: work moving along
board.body: Each column is a status, and tasks move left to right as the work goes from to do, to in progress, to done. The number beside each column's name says how many tasks it holds.

card.title: Open a task
card.body: Click a card to see everything about it: status, priority, due date, who it's assigned to, a checklist and comments. Drag a card into another column to move it on.

newTask.title: Add your own
newTask.body: New task adds one to this project. {{keys}} does the same from anywhere in the project.

search.title: Find anything
search.body: Search finds tasks, projects and documents, and runs any command by name. Press {{keys}} from anywhere.

help.title: Help is always here
help.body: The user guide, keyboard shortcuts and this tour are in Help. Tips like this one can be turned off in Settings › General.

overview.title: Overview: the project at a glance
overview.body: How many tasks are open, done this week and overdue, then what needs you, what's in progress and what's up next. Post an update to tell everyone how the project is going in a sentence or two.

list.title: List: every task in rows
list.body: Like a spreadsheet: click a heading to sort, choose what shows with Columns, and tick rows to change several tasks at once. Subtasks sit under their parent, like the meals under Plan the meals.

calendar.title: Calendar: tasks by due date
calendar.body: Each task sits on the day it's due, with milestones flagged. Switch between Month, Week, Year and Agenda, drag a task to another day to change its due date, and find tasks with no date under Unscheduled.

timeline.title: Timeline: plan across weeks
timeline.body: Each bar runs from a task's start to its due date, grouped under its milestone. Drag a bar to move it or an end to resize it, and turn on Show critical path to see which tasks can't slip.

milestones.title: Milestones and goals
milestones.body: A goal is what the project is for; milestones are the big moments on the way, each with a date and the tasks that lead to it. A milestone's bar fills in as its tasks are done.

library.title: Library: documents beside the work
library.body: Briefs, notes and documents for this project live here. Open Trip plan to read it, add your own with Add, and attach any of them to a task so it shows in that task's details.

decisions.title: Decisions: what was chosen and why
decisions.body: Record what was decided, the context, what else was weighed and what follows from it, so nobody has to remember later. A decision links to the tasks it affects, as this one links to Book the cabin.

drawer.title: Changes save as you go
drawer.body: There's no Save button: every change is kept as you make it. Press Ctrl+Z to undo the last one.

drawerResize.title: Make this panel wider
drawerResize.body: Drag the panel's left edge to give it more room or less. Each panel keeps the width you give it.

boardDrag.title: Drag to move a task on
boardDrag.body: Drag a card into another column to change its status. You can also open a card and pick a new status at the top.

list.title: Sort and compare
list.body: Click a column heading to sort by it. Shift+click another heading to sort by that one next.

calendar.title: Due dates at a glance
calendar.body: Tasks show on the day they're due. Drag one to another day to change its due date.

timeline.title: Plan across weeks
timeline.body: Each bar runs from a task's start to its due date. Drag a bar to move it, or drag either end to change how long it takes.

library.title: Documents next to the work
library.body: Keep briefs, notes and documents for this project here. Open one to read or edit it, or attach it to a task and it shows in that task's details.
